root_cause_analysis: Round 7 aborted in the C06 memory prelude at run eval-result-mem-C06_gmv_multi-40a4e2e5. Trace seq=19 failed on fetch_related_signal for the interaction/channel lane after select_signal_element had selected paid_ads. The budget was not exhausted: query_count was 52 under the compiled max_query 70, and all 52 sql_audit rows had guard_status=passed. The failure mechanism is the HEAD fetch_related_signal alias policy: when an explicit lane alias such as E3_ch_interaction is supplied, the tool still appends the selected element token, producing E3_ch_interaction_paid_ads. With this eval run id the evidence_id length is 65, exceeding evidence.evidence_id varchar(64). A rollback-only insert test confirmed that the intended unsuffixed evidence_id eval-result-mem-C06_gmv_multi-40a4e2e5:E3_ch_interaction is length 56 and would persist. Therefore the active blocker is a tool-layer evidence alias contract bug exposed by multisignal discovery, not discovery budget, SQL safety, or ranking.

proposed_fix.description: Change fetch_related_signal so an explicit evidence_alias is treated as the complete stable lane alias and is not suffixed with the selected element. Preserve the legacy dimension-derived alias path for calls without evidence_alias. Add a length-constrained regression test using the Round 7 long eval run id and interaction channel lane.
proposed_fix.estimated_impact: Allows C06 and related broad GMV multisignal lanes to persist interaction/conversion E3 evidence under long eval run ids without changing candidate discovery, ranking, or SQL guard behavior.

stall_reason: Round 6 selected FIX-D for plan budget sizing. Round 7 switches to FIX-T for a distinct tool alias persistence contract. The same case is failing across rounds, but not with the same fix_category, so this is not a same-category stall.
